taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Kenpoly-sec-school-field, Bori Metropolis. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1874 | 2.78 | 2.78
2 | 2428 | 9.13 | 11.9
3 | 1071 | 15.2 | 27.1
4 | 3706 | 32.2 | 59.3
5 | 178 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AAK-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Kenpoly-sec-school-field, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Kenpoly-sec-school-field, Bori Metropolis**

The VES sounding reveals a five-layer geoelectric model:
- **Layer 1:** 1874 Ω·m, thickness 2.78 m (depth 2.78 m)
- **Layer 2:** 2428 Ω·m, thickness 9.13 m (depth 11.9 m)
- **Layer 3:** 1071 Ω·m, thickness 15.2 m (depth 27.1 m)
- **Layer 4:** 3706 Ω·m, thickness 32.2 m (depth 59.3 m)
- **Layer 5:** 178 Ω·m (basal unit)

Evaluation of consecutive resistivity triplets:
- Layers 1–2–3 ($1874 < 2428 > 1071$ Ω·m) correspond to **K-type**.
- Layers 2–3–4 ($2428 > 1071 < 3706$ Ω·m) correspond to **H-type**.
- Layers 3–4–5 ($1071 < 3706 > 178$ Ω·m) correspond to **K-type**.

The true sounding curve is **KHK-type**. The on-file classification of **AAK-type** is incorrect and does not fit the interpreted resistivity model.

{"curve_type_stated": "AAK", "label_issue_flagged": true}
